items.question: 1. Introduction to Prompt Engineering
items.answer: Learn what Prompt Engineering is, why it is important, how Large Language Models (LLMs) work with prompts, and where Prompt Engineering is used in real-world AI applications.

items.question: 2. Fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence
items.answer: Understand the basics of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Neural Networks, and how modern AI systems process information.

items.question: 3. Understanding Large Language Models (LLMs)
items.answer: Explore GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, and other LLMs, including how they generate responses and their strengths and limitations.

items.question: 4. How AI Interprets Prompts
items.answer: Learn how AI understands instructions, context, system prompts, user prompts, tokens, and response generation mechanisms.

items.question: 5. Types of Prompts
items.answer: Study Zero-shot, One-shot, Few-shot, Chain-of-Thought, Role-based, Instruction-based, and Contextual prompting techniques.

items.question: 6. Prompt Structure & Anatomy
items.answer: Understand the essential components of an effective prompt including instructions, context, constraints, examples, and expected output.

items.question: 7. Writing Clear & Effective Prompts
items.answer: Master best practices for creating prompts that generate accurate, consistent, and high-quality AI responses.

items.question: 8. Prompt Optimization Techniques
items.answer: Learn how to refine prompts through iteration, prompt chaining, temperature control, output formatting, and performance improvements.

items.question: 9. Context Management in Prompts
items.answer: Understand how to maintain conversation context, memory, token limits, and long-form interactions with AI models.

items.question: 10. Prompt Engineering with ChatGPT
items.answer: Use ChatGPT effectively for automation, research, writing, coding, learning, productivity, and business workflows.

items.question: 11. Prompting for Content Creation
items.answer: Generate blogs, marketing copy, social media posts, emails, product descriptions, scripts, and creative writing using advanced prompts.

items.question: 12. Prompt Engineering for Coding
items.answer: Create efficient prompts for code generation, debugging, testing, documentation, refactoring, and software development.

items.question: 13. Prompt Engineering for Data & Analysis
items.answer: Leverage AI for data analysis, report generation, spreadsheet automation, visualization, and business intelligence tasks.

items.question: 14. Advanced Prompt Techniques
items.answer: Explore advanced methods including Tree-of-Thought, Self-Consistency, Multi-Step Prompting, ReAct prompting, and AI workflows.

items.question: 15. Prompt Debugging & Error Handling
items.answer: Identify weak prompts, reduce hallucinations, improve reliability, troubleshoot incorrect outputs, and optimize prompt quality.

items.question: 16. Ethics, Bias & Safe Prompting
items.answer: Understand responsible AI usage, prompt safety, bias reduction, privacy, security, and ethical AI practices.

items.question: 17. Prompt Engineering Tools & Platforms
items.answer: Explore popular AI platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Perplexity, Cursor AI, and API-based workflows.

items.question: 18. Prompt Templates & Reusability
items.answer: Build reusable prompt libraries, standardized templates, prompt variables, and workflow automation for faster productivity.

items.question: 19. Real-World Use Cases & Case Studies
items.answer: Analyze practical Prompt Engineering applications across cybersecurity, software development, education, healthcare, finance, and business.

items.question: 20. Capstone Project & Career Guidance
items.answer: Complete a real-world Prompt Engineering project, build a professional portfolio, prepare for interviews, and explore career opportunities in AI.
